headline_marked: 2 [[crude bombs detonated during AL procession]] in Gulshan
headline: 2 crude bombs detonated during AL procession in Gulshan
summary: Police arrested two people and recovered five additional crude bombs after activists of the banned Awami League attempted to hold a procession in Dhaka.
details: Two crude bombs were detonated during a procession by activists of the banned Awami League (AL) in Dhaka's Gulshan area yesterday.
Gulshan Police Station OC Daud Hossain stated that approximately 150-200 people attempted to bring out a procession on Road 3 of Gulshan 1 around 11:45 am.
According to the police, the activists blasted the bombs when officers tried to disperse the crowd.
Police responded by firing two rounds of rubber bullets to disperse the activists and regain control of the area.
Two individuals were arrested from the spot, and police recovered five additional crude bombs left behind by the protesters.
The Awami League's Dhaka city north unit confirmed via a Facebook post that they had organized the procession.
caption:
Two crude bombs blast in Gulshan as banned AL activists hold procession.

Two crude bombs were detonated during a procession by activists of the banned Awami League (AL) in Dhaka's Gulshan area yesterday.

Gulshan Police Station OC Daud Hossain stated that approximately 150-200 people attempted to bring out a procession on Road 3 of Gulshan 1 around 11:45 am.

According to the police, the activists blasted the bombs when officers tried to disperse the crowd.

Police responded by firing two rounds of rubber bullets to disperse the activists and regain control of the area.

Two individuals were arrested from the spot, and police recovered five additional crude bombs left behind by the protesters.

The Awami League's Dhaka city north unit confirmed via a Facebook post that they had organized the procession.

headline_marked: PM launches [[3-month nationwide dengue prevention]] and cleanliness campaign
headline: PM launches 3-month nationwide dengue prevention and cleanliness campaign
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman called for public cooperation to control the disease and keep the country clean, urging citizens to dedicate one hour a week to cleaning.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman inaugurated a nationwide dengue prevention and cleanliness campaign on Saturday morning at the South Plaza of the National Parliament building.
The campaign, which runs from September 12 to December 12, will focus on maximizing efforts to combat the dengue problem over the next three months.
The Prime Minister emphasized that while a 100% solution may not be immediate, effective measures will be taken to bring the situation under control.
He urged citizens to avoid throwing trash indiscriminately and highlighted that every citizen has a role in building a clean country.
Tarique Rahman called on the people to dedicate at least one hour per week to cleanliness activities to bring about a visible change in the situation.
He stated that the events of August 5, 2024, proved that change is possible, and urged the nation to now work together to transform the state.
Prior to the main event, the Prime Minister visited various stalls and interacted with the general public.
caption:
One hour a week for a cleaner Bangladesh. PM Tarique Rahman launches a 3-month nationwide fight against dengue.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman inaugurated a nationwide dengue prevention and cleanliness campaign on Saturday morning at the South Plaza of the National Parliament building.

The campaign, which runs from September 12 to December 12, will focus on maximizing efforts to combat the dengue problem over the next three months.

The Prime Minister emphasized that while a 100% solution may not be immediate, effective measures will be taken to bring the situation under control.

He urged citizens to avoid throwing trash indiscriminately and highlighted that every citizen has a role in building a clean country.

Tarique Rahman called on the people to dedicate at least one hour per week to cleanliness activities to bring about a visible change in the situation.

He stated that the events of August 5, 2024, proved that change is possible, and urged the nation to now work together to transform the state.

Prior to the main event, the Prime Minister visited various stalls and interacted with the general public.
